videos.title: 사전투표 반영 오후 1시 투표율 46.0%…전국 곳곳 투표 행렬 / 연합뉴스TV (YonhapnewsTV)
videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants me to summarize a YouTube video caption in Korean within approximately 500 characters. The video is about the 9th National Simultaneous Local Elections voting day.
Key points from the caption:
1. It's the 9th National Simultaneous Local Elections main voting day
2. As of 1 PM, voting rate is 46.0% (including early voting)
3. Seoul voting rate is 46.1% as of noon, increased significantly in one hour
4. Early voting enthusiasm seems to continue to main voting
5. Voting is happening at 2,266 polling stations in Seoul
6. Voting process is two-tiered: first for mayor/education superintendent/district head, then separate ballot for city council/district council/proportional representatives
7. Must vote at designated polling station (different from early voting)
8. Need photo ID (resident registration card, passport, driver's license) - photos of IDs or mobile captures not allowed
9. No photography inside polling booths or posting ballots on SNS
10. Can take certification shots with stamp on back of hand or outside polling station
11. Police on highest alert (Gapo emergency) until vote counting ends
12. Voting ends at 6 PM
13. Gyeongnam is mentioned as a key battleground
I need to summarize this in 3-5 sentences, around 500 characters, strictly in Korean only.
